local-trust-boundary.title: What a local agent can reach
local-trust-boundary.description: Agent requests pass approval choices, then an optional local sandbox, before reaching the files, network, credentials and processes your account can reach.

trusted-directories.title: Decide where a session starts
trusted-directories.description: Launch only in a trusted folder, review untrusted folders first, and relaunch in a narrower project folder instead of your home directory or a broad root.

permission-modes.title: Compare permission modes
permission-modes.description: Manual asks you, assisted sends requests to an AI safety review that can escalate, and allow-all approves tools, paths and URLs; none replaces the sandbox.

approval-persistence.title: How long an approval lasts
approval-persistence.description: One-time approvals end with the action, session approvals last until the session ends and return on resume, and saved choices and rules persist until removed.

cli-tool-rules.title: Resolve a CLI tool request
cli-tool-rules.description: Deny rules win first, then allow rules or allow-all flags, otherwise Copilot CLI prompts; paths and URLs are checked separately.

terminal-auto-approve.title: Evaluate a terminal command
terminal-auto-approve.description: VS Code splits chained commands and checks each part against auto-approve rules; an explicit ask beats an allow, and any part that needs approval prompts.

sandbox-filesystem.title: Resolve path access in the sandbox
sandbox-filesystem.description: Denied beats any grant, the more specific of read-only and read/write grants wins, and anything not granted stays denied by default.

sandbox-network.title: Check an outbound connection
sandbox-network.description: Deny rules win, any allow rule turns outbound access into an allowlist, and otherwise outbound access follows the Allow outbound switch.

credential-masking.title: How credential masking works
credential-masking.description: A sandboxed command sees a placeholder, the local proxy swaps in the real credential only for HTTPS to approved hosts, and an approved bypass skips both.

least-privilege-tokens.title: Which token Copilot CLI uses
least-privilege-tokens.description: Copilot CLI checks three environment variables, then the keychain OAuth token, then the GitHub CLI token, and uses the first one it finds.

isolation-tiers.title: Compare isolation tiers
isolation-tiers.description: A local sandbox, dev container, codespace and cloud sandbox each separate different things from your machine, and each leaves a residual risk.

local-incident-response.title: Respond to an unexpected agent action
local-incident-response.description: Stop the session, inspect changes and commands, review granted access, recover files, then report and rotate credentials; resetting approvals is not revocation.
